dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: You're here. Need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Kinich! Show a little enthusiasm, would you? These are guests of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw! And it is your honor to be our servant!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Ignore him. Just tell me what you need.
